headline: NBA: Giannis drops 34 and Klay returns with 26 as Heat pull away from Pistons 137-117
teaser: Miami puts on a second-half offensive clinic at Kaseya Center as Giannis Antetokounmpo posts 34 points, 14 rebounds, and 8 assists, overpowering Cade Cunningham's 33 points for Detroit.
story:
The Miami Heat delivered an offensive masterpiece on Saturday night, 14 November, pulling away from the Detroit Pistons for a 137-117 victory at Kaseya Center.

Giannis Antetokounmpo paced the Heat with 34 points, 14 rebounds, and 8 assists, shooting 13 of 19 from the field. Sharpshooter Klay Thompson returned after missing two games with stiffness, catching fire from the perimeter to hit 7 three-pointers on his way to 26 points.

Detroit fought courageously behind guard Cade Cunningham, who finished with 33 points and 8 assists, but Miami's bench outscored Detroit's reserves 48-28 to secure the comfortable home victory.
whyCareReason: Giannis and Klay power a resurgent Miami offense while Cunningham continues his torrid November scoring streak.
stakes: Miami improves to 8-4 in the Eastern Conference, while Detroit falls to 6-6.
rivalryAngle: Eastern Conference rivalry rekindled with dynamic star power leading modern iterations of both historic franchises.
funFacts: Klay Thompson made seven three-pointers on nine attempts in his return from a two-game absence.
Giannis Antetokounmpo was two assists shy of his 49th career triple-double.
Cade Cunningham logged his fifth 30-point performance through twelve games this season.

keyPlayers.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
keyPlayers.hook: Dominated the paint with 34 points, 14 boards, and 8 assists on 13 of 19 shooting.

keyPlayers.name: Cade Cunningham
keyPlayers.hook: Kept Detroit competitive with 33 points and 8 assists against Miami's switching defense.
